summary: This is a prospectus supplement for a registered follow-on offering of 9,859,155 shares of common stock by Cytokinetics Inc. at $71.00 per share, expected to yield $700M in proceeds. The underwriters, led by Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, and Jefferies, have a 30-day option for an additional 1,478,873 shares. The offering is a standard public equity raise under an existing shelf registration (Form S-3). There is no special-situation event such as a merger, tender, spin-off, or restructuring; it is a routine capital markets transaction. The risk-arb angle is not applicable.
